name: Wall Drug
summary: The most famous roadside attraction in America — a whole block of a store that grew from a Depression-era offer of free ice water into a signposted legend.

lodging.name: A Wall motel
lodging.blurb: At the edge of the Badlands.

foodMustTry.name: A hot beef sandwich & a donut
foodMustTry.blurb: At the Wall Drug cafe — and the free ice water.

item.title: Wall Drug
item.blurb: The sprawling, gloriously kitschy emporium famous from billboards for hundreds of miles — jackalopes, a giant dinosaur, and all.

commute.scenicNote: East across the prairie to Pierre.
